scope: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL on four CPU sockets (tensor parallel, the DFlash drafter and the six defects between it and a working one, the MTP dead end, grouped-query split-KV flash attention, x16 GEMM, F32 vision projector, XML tool-call parsing, memory guards), GLM-5.3-Flash production revisions g-l and the depth campaign, Cascade Lake VNNI micro-benchmarks, and Qwen-Image-2.1 on CPU
policy: Curated subset assembled with redaction built in. Text is preserved except where an ordered transform replaces an operator name or home path, another project's name, or a link to a private note; such files are marked filtered and carry both hashes. Evidence JSON passes through tools/export_tuning_snapshot.py clean() plus a guard that drops prompts, completions and response text and turns long strings into length/hash summaries. Compiled artifacts and images are refused outright; raw op traces, server logs and per-request captures are excluded and listed. Two sections of STATE-SPECULATION-20260922.md carry a dated note, added at publication, pointing to the later finding in this snapshot that overturned them.
